A failed scan rolls back changes, retains the previous snapshot, and blocks current retrieval until a successful rescan.

Scrubbing removes active logical content; it does not guarantee forensic erasure from SQLite WAL, filesystem backups, or previously returned responses.

facts.text: The owner sets a fixed workspace and collection scope at MCP startup; neither evidence tool accepts scope arguments, and changing configuration requires restarting the process.
The agent receives read access to the entire selected scope. The scope does not prevent it from forwarding retrieved text to its configured model provider.
The local trust boundary is private stdio or the existing bearer-token gate for optional loopback TCP; this does not supply authenticated per-user organizational access enforcement.
Both memory privacy switches must be enabled and unavailable settings fail closed. The evidence allowlist does not govern separate personal-memory tools.
